panels.note: The same source curves and crossing order, shown with even stroke widths. This presentation does not alter the native band's width or topology.

evidence.name: Interior selection
evidence.basis: Actual source curve cycles, or selected native mesh ports
evidence.note: A closed boundary read and a proposed interior scaffold are separate. Neither certifies general containment.

evidence.name: Compound enrichment
evidence.basis: Reusable local curves, bands and internal guides
evidence.note: Several ribs, lobes, scrolls and centre elements work as one compound; this is a construction count, not a cognitive complexity estimate.

evidence.name: Placement dependency
evidence.basis: Interior read → explicit anchor → native substitution and sum receipts
evidence.note: The native application consumes the actual derived centre word or a declared corner-relative focus; an unrepresentable centre is never rounded.

evidence.name: Colour focus
evidence.basis: Connected selection and colour intent; historical design heuristics
evidence.note: Colour and stroke choices deliberately promote a layer. Display contrast does not prove perceptual attention.

evidence.name: Preserved mesh
evidence.basis: Exact native envelope identities, repetition substrate and seam correspondence
evidence.note: The old detail is retained as provenance, outside the new output. Even outlines are a selected centre-path presentation, not a mesh mutation.

audit.limits: Authored compartment selection and local motifs. No generic face discovery, fill containment, general collision solver, metric circle or trained aesthetic judgement.
